title: Campaign Performance Report
subtitle: Transform raw campaign data into a visual story that drives the Q4 budget decision.
ai_tool: Any AI tool (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, Gemini)

data_files.role: Genpact Enterprise Intelligence Suite launch — $1.72M spend across 6 channels, 1,847 leads, 67 opportunities vs 150 target (44.7% attainment), cost-per-opportunity by channel, monthly trend, audience segment breakdown

learning_objectives: Choose a stack that makes channel comparison data immediately scannable — the best and worst performers must be unmissable
Read a campaign dataset and find the non-obvious insight before building — not just the headline miss
Validate that your prompt names the worst channel ($270k per opp) and the best ($12,917) explicitly before firing
Build a campaign postmortem that gives leadership a clear Q4 budget reallocation decision
Deliver a decision-ready report that replaces a 20-slide deck with one interactive HTML file
deliverable: Single-file interactive HTML campaign performance report
